newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - I2 started by Everen.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - I2 started by Everen.

text.p: --Everen Securities analyst William Lanzon said he started coverage of I2 Technologies Inc with a 2-1 rating, or market performer intermediate-term and outperform long-term, for aggresssive investors.
--Shares in the client/server software concern were off 5/8 to 37-3/8.
--"We believe that I2 can continue to increase revenues at a rapid pace and gain market share in the early stages of a potentially large market," Lanzon said.
